title: Homage Drops New Sports-Themed Hello Kitty Apparel Line: Here’s How to Buy the Collection Online
summary: The Hello Kitty collection features some of your favorite teams from the New York Yankees to the Los Angeles Dodgers.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

You can now rep your favorite sports team the Hello Kitty way with Homage’s latest collection.

The Ohio-based apparel brand launched a 30-piece collection with the iconic character and MLB , NFL and soccer teams. Within the collection, you’ll be able to spot Hello Kitty in some of your favorite sports teams’ uniforms from the Los Angeles Rams and New York Yankees to the United States women’s national soccer team, otherwise known as USWNT.

Shop Homage X Hello Kitty

The famed kitty is plastered on the front of hoodies, tees and crewnecks, pitching balls and kicking field goals. Sizing is available for both men and women from XS to 3XL, along with youth sizing. Every style is available to shop right now at Homage.com .

Scroll down and shop a few of our favorites that you can easily shop below:

Hello Kitty x L.A. Rams Kickoff Crewneck

$72

Buy Now at homage

This is a gray crew neck style from Homage x Hello Kitty. The long sleeve features Hello Kitty on the front, punting a football in L.A. Rams attire.

Bringing whimsy and fun to the field, this Hello Kitty crew neck from Homage features L.A. Rams-themed graphics that incorporate some of the team’s yellow and blue coloring. The center of the long sleeve is affixed with your favorite kitty punting a football, hoping to get herself a field goal or two. Hello Kitty’s attire, down to her signature bow, is reflective of the Rams’ colors. She’s even wearing face paint. This crew neck is made of a mix of 50% cotton, 43% polyester and 7% rayon, which makes it thick and warm, but not stuffy. It is also lined with fleece, keeping the wearer extra cozy for those cold nights sat in the stands.

Women's Hello Kitty x L.A. Dodgers Pitch

$40

This is a light gray tee from Homage x Hello Kitty that comes in a slew of sizes. This tee features Hello Kitty tossing a baseball in L.A. Dodgers gear.

From football to baseball, Hello Kitty is trying her hand at pitching a ball on this Homage x Hello Kitty tee . This time, she’s seen repping the L.A. Dodgers. A baseball diamond can be seen behind our little kitty friend while a Dodgers cap is affixed to her head. This light gray tee is slightly oversized for a casual fit and is made of a mix of 50% polyester, 25% cotton and 25% rayon. This shirt is extremely lightweight and breezy, which could come in handy on hot game days during the summer.

Hello Kitty x USWNT Hoodie

$80

This is a gray hoodie from Homage’s collaboration with Hello Kitty. The sweatshirt features the USWNT (United States women’s national soccer team) coloring and Hello Kitty in the center of it all perched on a soccer ball.

This soccer-themed Hello Kitty x Homage hoodie could be handy for keeping warm. The hoodie features USWNT coloring, red and blue sans the white, with Hello Kitty in the center perched on top of a soccer ball. This hoodie is bulky and oversized for warmth and comes with drawstring closures to adjust the hood if needed. The front-facing pocket is also a nice touch, keeping your belongings close by and your hands warm all at once.

Hello Kitty x New York Yankees Swing

This is a light gray tee from Homage x Hello Kitty. The shirt features Yankees iconography on the front above Hello Kitty, who can be seen hitting a baseball with her bat.

Hello Kitty is taking a swing at baseball once again, up to bat with the New York Yankees on this collaborative Homage x Hello Kitty tee . The light gray style features a graphic of the kitty swinging her bat, ready to hit a baseball coming her way. She is, of course, wearing a Yankees uniform down to the hat on her little kitty head. This is a breathable and comfortable tee from the collection with a composition of 50% polyester, 25% cotton and 25% rayon. This mixture is lightweight and comfortable. The high percentage of polyester also makes this shirt durable, able to withstand many washes.

Meanwhile, Homage has many collaborations under its belt. In February 2025, the brand launched a multipiece NBA x Grateful Dead collection . Even Atlanta-based hip-hop group Outkast got in on the Homage fun in November 2025, launching a line of tees, hoodies and crewnecks inspired by iconic images from Outkast’s career, including art from their albums  ATLiens and Stankonia .
